what_to_detect: A combat damage step in which each attacking and blocking creature deals damage equal to its power, and a creature of power 0 or less has no damage_dealt event.
near_miss: A combat damage step in which a creature of power 0 or less is in combat and deals nothing.
record_fields: combat payload events: damage_dealt (amount, cause, subjects)

what_to_detect: A combat damage step in which an unblocked attacker's damage goes to the player, planeswalker or battle it attacks, and an attacker attacking nothing deals none.
near_miss: A combat damage step in which the attacker was blocked and its damage went to the blocker.
record_fields: combat payload events: damage_dealt (amount, cause, subjects)

what_to_detect: A combat damage step in which a blocked attacker assigns all its damage to its blocker (or divided among several blockers) and, with no blockers left, assigns none.
near_miss: A combat damage step in which an unblocked attacker's damage goes to the defender.
record_fields: combat payload events: damage_dealt (amount, cause, subjects)

what_to_detect: A combat damage step in which a blocking creature assigns its damage to the creature(s) it blocks, and none if it blocks nothing.
near_miss: A combat damage step in which a blocker is no longer blocking anything and deals no damage.
record_fields: combat payload events: damage_dealt (amount, cause, subjects)

what_to_detect: A combat damage step in which creatures that die from the damage still dealt their own damage in the same step: damage_dealt events from every attacker and blocker in one step, including from creatures that then die in the state-based check.
near_miss: A combat in which damage is split over two steps (first strike), so a creature killed in the first step deals no damage in the second.
record_fields: combat payload events: damage_dealt (amount, cause, subjects)

what_to_detect: A trigger on a creature dying fires in the combat damage step, from a creature the state-based check after combat damage put into the graveyard, before a player gets priority.
near_miss: A trigger of the same kind evaluated in the combat damage step that does not fire.
record_fields: trigger record snapshot global.phase and combat_substep
